U.S. DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY Final Technical Report (FTR) Award Number: DE-EE0010673 Recipient: University of Texas at Dallas Principal Investigator: Rotea, Mario Project Title: Center for Wind Energy Project Objectives: The purpose is to establish the physical infrastructure and additional measurement equipment for a center focused on wind energy research, education, technology development and community outreach. The Center will be located on the Richardson campus of UTD. The Center for Wind Energy will bring together university, civic and industry partners to create and test new technologies to realize the potential of wind to support the energy needs of the nation. The purpose was to establish the physical infrastructure for a center focused on wind energy research, education, technology development and community outreach. The Center is located on the Richardson campus of UTD within the same building as the Boundary Layer and Subsonic Wind Tunnel (BLAST) to enable stronger team science in wind energy systems by locating the faculty, students and staff with the wind tunnel. The project provided for the acquisition of vital equipment for scale and field testing to further research objectives, education and outreach.
